COVERAGE

California statewide CSLB licensing

California licenses contractors statewide through the CSLB. Our current dataset prioritizes top high-impact counties from official CSLB public list extracts — not a complete statewide dump of every county file. Always confirm live status on CSLB Instant License Check.

Common classes: B — General Building · C-10 — Electrical · C-36 — Plumbing · C-39 — Roofing · C-20 — HVAC · A — General Engineering.

California statewide CSLB licensing (this extract prioritizes top high-impact counties) · License number, business name, CLEAR status, primary + multi-class codes · City / county / ZIP and phone when present · Bond and workers’ comp fields as published in the list extract
